investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ironen Academy (online learning); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.74.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ironen-prod-eastus (AKS); Automation: an in-house node-recycler controller rotates worker nodes (cordon, drain, terminate, replace) in batches bounded by maxUnavailable (20% of 13 nodes); runs are recorded with RECYCLE- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
